dense_built_low_green.means: Persistently hot, densely built with little vegetation.
check: Nearest public buildings for cooling points

open_bare_or_industrial.means: Persistently hot with low built share and low vegetation: bare ground or industrial land.
check: Industrial heat sources (not visible to Landsat)

episodic.means: Hot in some scenes but not consistently.
check: Which dates were hot (events, fires, harvest burning)

chronic_other.means: Persistently hot without the dense-built or bare-land pattern.
check: Local land cover and surface materials

not_hot.means: Not among the hotter wards in this city on this analysis.

undetermined.means: Not enough valid data to type this ward.
